avis.auteur: 35yo woman getting into the tret game
avis.titre: A Better Occlusive Than an Emoillient
avis.texte: I wanted to like this moisturizer a lot, as I like the Peach & Lily Brand in general because of their clean ingredients, avoidance of silicones and sustainable packaging. Howver, I found that this moisturizer when used alone did not quite cut it for me. I'm in the middle of upping my tret game, which means I'm also in the middle of the peeling and purging phase. So while my skin isn't super dry per se, it is still peeling quite a bit and requires a ton more moisture than general. This moisturizer sits on top and absorbs only a little. But definitely lasts as an occlusive agent (I can still feel it when I wash my face the next time). Sent is faint, almost waxy. A little goes a very long way however. I have the travel size pot and I will definitely be using it for a while. I didn't find that it made my purging worse, so it doesn't seem to break me out. I would recommend this moisturizer if you already use a light weight and absorbable moisturizer and want to layer a thicker, occlussive-leaning moisturizer on top.

I was so excited to try this out. I had been using the la roche possay double repair moisturizer, but I had a gift card and wanted something a little nicer & that would help with redness. Ive never reallt struggled with acne but I noticed after using this for awhile that I was starting to develop cystic acne on my neck and hairline. I even started to get this large pus filled bumps on my cheeks that looked like bug bites- Ive never had acne line that before. I wasnt sure if it was stress/diet related, so I took a break from this mousturizer for awhile and gave my skin time to heal. After recently using this product again over the last few weeks, I can confirm this is the source of my inflamed breakouts :(. Ive been using this again for about 3-4 weeks and a few days ago developed more neck acne and 2 more of those pus filled papules on my cheeks! The last one even left a scar :(. Do not buy this, it has a comedogenic formula and I didnt notice any help with redness (it def made my red areas worse).

avis.texte: I was kind of pressured into buying this by an employee on black friday. I dont know much about the brand, other than its pretty expensive. I am someone with sensitive skin and bought this because it is touted as being safe for that. Firstly, it says fragrance free, it is 100% percent not fragrance free, (they probably mean that it doesn't have artificial fragrance). It smell way too strong and very unpleasant. Second, I applied this product and 2 minutes passed and I could feel my skin feel super tight (not moisturized in the slightest).
